name: Glints Indonesia
decision: Exclude automated collection; request written consent if wanted
reason: SRS 4.1 records a terms clause forbidding screen scraping/data mining/robots without prior written consent. Re-verification on 2026-10-17 failed: terms pages (id, id/en, vn) returned HTTP 403, so the clause was not re-read. robots.txt disallows /api/gt/ and job explore pages with query parameters.

name: JobStreet Indonesia (SEEK)
decision: Exclude; only via written permission from SEEK
reason: Terms effective 20 July 2026 prohibit data mining, robots, screen scraping (s.7(d)), automated scripts/bots/scrapers (s.9(b)), and aggregating or copying any content including expired job listings (s.7(b)(ii)). robots.txt disallows */job/, query-string URLs, /graphql and /api/jobsearch/ for generic agents.
retention_constraints: Content limited to personal non-commercial use (s.5(c)).

name: LinkedIn Jobs
decision: Exclude
reason: User Agreement (eff. 3 Nov 2025) s.8.2 prohibits scraping/copying the Services and bots. robots.txt has 'User-agent: * Disallow: /' and requires whitelisting via whitelist-crawl@linkedin.com. The Job Posting API only pushes jobs into LinkedIn and is closed to new partners.

name: Indeed Indonesia
decision: Exclude; only via written permission from Indeed
reason: Terms (updated 1 April 2026) s.21 prohibit automated systems (bots, scrapers, spiders, AI) to access or mine data without Indeed's written permission, and copying/extracting site content. Job seeker licence is personal and non-commercial. The Job Sync API is an inbound ATS-partner API, not a search/read API.
retention_constraints: Personal, non-commercial use only for job seekers.

name: Kalibrr
decision: Ask permission; keep disabled
reason: Terms (last updated March 2026) forbid reproducing, copying or distributing materials 'without written permission from Kalibrr and the relevant owners'; third-party sites may syndicate only with 'Kalibrr's explicit permission'. Terms also say Kalibrr monitors 'automated extraction, scraping'.
retention_constraints: Materials for personal, non-commercial use only absent permission.

name: Dealls
decision: Investigate; contact Dealls for written permission
reason: The only terms found (modified 6 Oct 2026) govern the Dealls/KantorKu HRIS products and do not clearly cover the public job site; s.9.6(2) forbids sharing content or information on the Product without Dealls Group's written consent. robots.txt says 'Allow: /', which is not permission.

name: KitaLulus
decision: Exclude; only via written permission
reason: Terms prohibit accounts used for 'scraping content', and to 'Combine, copy, or duplicate any KitaLulus content or information' and 'Reproducing KitaLulus content for public use'. Commercial use of any part of the Services is prohibited.

name: Karir.com
decision: Exclude; only via written permission from PT Qerja Manfaat Bangsa
reason: Terms s.9.2 prohibit 'menggunakan pengambilan data otomatis tanpa izin' (automated data retrieval without permission); s.8.5 forbids non-personal or commercial use of any Platform content without written permission. robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 1.
retention_constraints: Content for personal, non-commercial use only (s.8.4).

name: Loker.id
decision: Investigate; terms page not readable
reason: Terms page returned HTTP 403 on fetch; search snippets show only general terms (effective 1 April 2007) without a visible copying/automation clause. robots.txt has an empty Disallow, which is not permission. Ask the operator in writing.

name: Pintarnya
decision: Ask permission; keep disabled
reason: Terms (since November 2023) s.H.2 require written permission from Pintarnya to reproduce, copy, distribute or use any Pintarnya material or content commercially. No explicit scraping clause found. robots.txt blocks company pages and search/sort parameters.

name: TopKarir
decision: Investigate whether site is still active
reason: topkarir.com and www.topkarir.com refused connections (ECONNREFUSED) on 2026-10-17; robots.txt and terms could not be retrieved. No current terms found by search. The site may be inactive.

name: HiredToday Indonesia
decision: Investigate; contact operator
reason: Terms and privacy pages are client-rendered and returned only template placeholders, so their text could not be read. robots.txt allows /jobseeker/jobs JSON endpoints for crawlers, but robots.txt is not a grant of reuse rights.

name: Tech in Asia Jobs
decision: Investigate; terms not retrieved
reason: The fetch tool could not access techinasia.com (terms, robots.txt and /jobs all failed), and search did not surface its terms. No evidence either way.

name: Pasker ID (Pusat Pasar Kerja, Kemnaker)
decision: Exclude automated collection; request data-sharing agreement from Pusat Pasar Kerja
reason: Ketentuan Pengguna s.3.2e prohibits 'kode computer otomatis, proses program, robot, net crawler, spider'; s.3.1 and s.4 limit use to personal, non-commercial purposes and forbid copying or redistribution. robots.txt has an empty Disallow, which does not override the terms.
retention_constraints: Personal non-commercial use only; redistribution prohibited (s.4).

name: Pasker ID Dataset Pasar Kerja (aggregate CSV/XLSX)
decision: Ask permission for public display; candidate for benchmark use
reason: Aggregate vacancy/job-seeker statistics (38 provinces, 2022-2024, CSV/XLSX) are downloadable, but the page states no licence and the site terms limit content to personal non-commercial use. Written confirmation of reuse terms is needed before display.
attribution_requirements: Unknown; cite Pusat Pasar Kerja Indonesia, Kemnaker as a minimum.

name: Karirhub (SIAPkerja, Kemnaker)
decision: Ask Kemnaker / Pusat Pasar Kerja for a data-sharing agreement
reason: Public vacancy listings are visible, but no terms, licence or API link was found on the homepage. robots.txt contains only a content-signals comment with no directives and no assigned signals. The sibling Pasker ID portal of the same operator prohibits crawlers, so permission cannot be inferred.

name: SSCASN (BKN civil-service selection)
decision: Investigate; at most manual curation of official announcements as public-sector category
reason: Homepage shows Sekolah Kedinasan 2026 info and links to FAQ, Dasar Hukum, Formasi and a helpdesk, but no terms, privacy or API link was found. Recruitment is periodic and distinct from labour-market vacancies.

name: Greenhouse Job Board API
decision: Activate per employer only after recorded employer consent
reason: Docs state 'Job Board data is publicly available, so authentication is not required for any GET endpoints', but describe the API as a way to build the customer's own careers pages. No Greenhouse terms covering third-party aggregation were found, so per-employer written consent is required.

name: Lever Postings API
decision: Activate per employer only after recorded employer consent
reason: Docs say 'This API is designed to help you create a job site' and note published jobs 'may be scraped by third parties'; that is an acknowledgement, not a licence. Lever's customer terms do not address third-party aggregators. jobs.lever.co robots.txt: Allow: /, Crawl-delay: 1.

name: SmartRecruiters Posting API
decision: Only with an employer-issued credential and written consent
reason: Docs say the Posting API supports API Key and OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials and is meant for building custom career sites; credentials belong to the employer. No terms permitting third-party aggregation were found.

name: Ashby public job posting API
decision: Activate per employer only after recorded employer consent
reason: Docs show an unauthenticated GET endpoint and say 'If you host your own careers page, you can use this data to populate it.' Ashby terms (updated 29 Sep 2025) cover customers and say nothing about third-party aggregators. jobs.ashbyhq.com robots.txt disallows /api/.

name: Workday-hosted career sites (myworkdayjobs.com)
decision: Only with written employer permission; no documented public posting API
reason: Workday site terms (updated 13 Aug 2026) prohibit 'data mining, robots or similar data gathering or extraction methods' on its Sites, but do not state whether tenant career sites are covered. No public read API is documented. Each tenant is a separate employer needing consent.

name: schema.org JobPosting structured data (Google for Jobs technique)
decision: Use only as a parser for pages already approved on their own terms
reason: Google's guidelines govern how publishers mark up their own pages for Google Search; they grant no reuse rights to third parties. Whether JSON-LD on a page may be collected depends entirely on that site's terms.
retention_constraints: If used, honour validThrough and remove expired postings.

name: Balikpapan open data: registered vacancies by education level
decision: Include as manual import of aggregate statistics only
reason: The dataset page, published by Dinas Ketenagakerjaan, states the licence as 'Other (Public Domain)' (CSV, updated 16 July 2026). It contains aggregate counts for one city, not individual vacancies.
attribution_requirements: None required by the stated licence; cite Dinas Ketenagakerjaan Kota Balikpapan anyway.
retention_constraints: None stated; store the licence text and download date with each import.

name: Satu Data Indonesia portal
decision: Investigate per dataset licence
reason: The homepage shows datasets labelled 'Terbuka' or 'Terbatas' but no portal-wide licence or terms. No national vacancy-level dataset was found. Each dataset's own licence must be checked.

name: BPS (Badan Pusat Statistik) labour statistics
decision: Investigate; verify terms-of-use text directly
reason: BPS term-of-use pages returned HTTP 403. Search snippets suggest a free, worldwide, non-exclusive licence with mandatory attribution, but this was not verified at the source. BPS data is labour-market context, not vacancies.

name: Kaggle Indonesian job-posting datasets (third-party scraped)
decision: Exclude from product; offline experiments only after licence check
reason: Dataset pages are client-rendered and showed no licence text when fetched. Several datasets (for example 'Jobstreet Indonesia Dataset') appear to be scraped from boards whose terms prohibit aggregation, so an uploader's licence cannot clear the original platform's rights.
